info.about: Quest 64 is a role-playing video game (RPG) developed by Imagineer for the Nintendo 64. It was released in North America in June 1998 by THQ, Europe in September 1998 by Konami and Japan in July 1999 by Imagineer.
info.trivia: The first RPG released for the N64 in North America.
info.why: THQ printed plenty and it was poorly reviewed, so supply is fine; its status as one of the console's few RPGs keeps a floor under the price.
